heros.infro: Anne Hutchinson was an American pioneer in Massachusetts, Rhode Island, and New Netherlands (New York). Her religious fervor and theological interpretations led to imprisonment and eventually her banishment. Her heresy was a belief that it was a blessing rather than a curse to be a woman. Her followers left the colony and Roger Williams co-founded the state of Rhode Island with her. She was pardoned by the state of Massachusetts in 1987.
heros.name: Anne Hutchinson
